_readme: To add a job, paste a new object into the 'jobs' array. 'id' must be a unique slug (lowercase, hyphens). Dates use YYYY-MM-DD and lastDate is optional. The company logo is picked up automatically from the apply link; see README.md for the optional 'website' and 'logo' fields.

jobs.batch: Experienced hiring (1+ years, not a fresher role)
jobs.eligibility: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, with 1+ years in software and applied AI/ML engineering
jobs.summary: Apple is hiring a Software Engineer (AI) in Bengaluru to build GenAI and agentic data products. 1+ years of AI/ML engineering experience required.
description: Apple is hiring a Software Engineer focused on AI for its Bengaluru location. The role is part of Information Systems and Technology (IS&T), the organisation that builds and runs the enterprise and customer technology systems behind Apple's business and supports around 2.5 billion active Apple devices. Within IS&T, the AI & Data Platforms (AiDP) team brings together data, application development and machine learning, including generative AI, to help Apple build and adopt AI-powered solutions faster.

You would join the Enterprise Data Warehouse team, which works with petabytes of data across real-time, near real-time and batch pipelines, and builds data-centric agentic solutions on top of those assets. The work supports business areas such as Retail, Sales, Operations, Finance, AppleCare, Marketing and Internet Services. In this role you are expected to understand a business challenge, work with business and cross-functional teams, design a statistical or deep learning solution, build it yourself or guide another engineer, deliver it to production and keep good governance of your work.

Please note that this is not an entry-level fresher opening, because Apple asks for at least 1+ years of experience in software and applied AI/ML engineering. The core requirements are strong Python or Java skills, hands-on experience with GenAI applications such as RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases and semantic search, and practical experience building AI agents or agentic workflows with frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex. If you are a graduate aiming for roles like this, build a small end-to-end RAG or agent project and be ready to explain how it works, how you tested it and how you would run it reliably in production.
responsibilities: Understand business challenges and turn ambiguous problems into scalable technical designs.
Collaborate with business and other cross-functional teams.
Design statistical or deep learning solutions to answer business questions.
Develop solutions yourself or guide another person to build them.
Deliver solutions into production with attention to governance, reliability and observability.
Build data-centric agentic solutions on large enterprise data assets.
requirements: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, with 1+ years in software and applied AI/ML engineering.
Programming proficiency in Python or Java.
Experience building GenAI-powered applications, including RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases and semantic search over structured and unstructured data.
Practical experience building AI agents or agentic workflows (planning, memory, tool use, execution loops) with frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex.
Preferred: full-stack development across backend APIs, data services and front-end layers.
Preferred: multi-agent systems, and cloud platforms (AWS preferred, GCP or Azure) with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Preferred: front-end or app frameworks such as React, Streamlit or FastAPI, and enterprise domain experience in Retail, Finance, Sales, Marketing or Operations analytics.
jobs.aboutCompany: Apple's Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organisation builds the enterprise and customer technology systems behind Apple's products and services. Apple states that accessibility is a fundamental human right and says this is reflected in its culture, benefits and digital tools.

jobs.eligibility: Bachelor's degree with 5+ years of analytical experience in a US MNC, consulting or banking; overall performance rating of 5 or above in the last review
jobs.workMode: Hybrid | Evening shift, Mon-Fri 2:30 PM to 1:00 AM IST
jobs.summary: American Express is hiring an experienced Analyst for its Data Analytics team in Gurugram. 5+ years of analytics experience required; apply before 26 Nov 2026.
description: American Express is hiring an Analyst in its Data Analytics function for the Client Hierarchy Centre of Excellence (COE) in Gurugram. This team focuses on understanding what global commercial clients need, advising them and delivering accurate, compliant data. It works closely with clients, strategic partners and many internal teams, including client management, implementation, onboarding, account consultancy, servicing, new accounts, technology and operational excellence. The person in this role will help solve a major client pain point and drive the adoption of digital products with stronger data capabilities.

The job is analytics-heavy. You will analyse complex datasets to spot trends and insights, build dashboards and reports in tools such as Power BI, Tableau or Looker, and write clean SQL queries and Python or R scripts. You will also manage data-cleansing projects for commercial programs, resolve client queries about data, and review client relationships at obligor level, using external sources such as LexisNexis, D&B reports and Secretary of State records to verify legal entities.

Please note that this is an experienced-hire position, not a fresher opening. The working hours are Monday to Friday, 2:30 PM to 1:00 AM IST in a hybrid model. Freshers can still use this listing to understand what skills MNC analytics teams expect at the next career level.
responsibilities: Lead data-cleansing projects for commercial programs together with client managers, administrators and technology teams.
Resolve client data queries with a strong customer-first approach.
Analyse trends and flag opportunities for a better customer experience and more digitisation.
Verify legal entities using external data sources and public tools.
Build reports, dashboards and data visualisations, and present insights to client managers.
Support accurate calculation of incentives with internal stakeholders.
Deliver high-quality work on tight timelines with minimal supervision.
requirements: Graduate (Bachelor's degree) with 5+ years of analytical experience in a US MNC, consulting firm or bank.
Strong SQL and at least one programming language, with Python preferred.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Ability to explain complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Willingness to learn web-based database platforms, AS400 mainframe screens and MySQL-based tools.
Excellent verbal and written communication, and attention to detail.
Overall performance rating of 5 or above in the last review.
jobs.aboutCompany: American Express describes a 175-year history of innovation and a strong focus on trust, security and service. Benefits listed in the posting include competitive salaries, bonus incentives, medical and insurance cover (depending on location), flexible hybrid working, paid parental leave, wellness support, counselling through its Healthy Minds programme and career development. An offer is subject to a successful background verification.

jobs.batch: Freshers and up to 2 years experience
jobs.eligibility: 15 years of full-time education (as stated by Accenture)
jobs.summary: Accenture is hiring a Technology Architecture Associate (0-2 years) in Bengaluru with Azure Stack as the must-have skill.
description: Accenture is hiring a Technology Architect at the Technology Architecture Associate level for its Bengaluru office. The role suits candidates with 0 to 2 years of experience. A Technology Architect designs and delivers the technology architecture for a platform, product or client engagement, and defines solutions that meet performance, capability and scalability needs. The main requirement is proficiency in Azure Stack, and knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server administration and Linux is a good addition.

In this position you are expected to build your knowledge, support the team and take part in problem-solving discussions. You will work with cross-functional teams to collect requirements and turn them into architectural solutions, help document designs and technical standards, and contribute ideas that make the architecture more efficient. As you gain experience you will also guide junior colleagues on architectural best practices.

The posting expects a good understanding of cloud infrastructure and hybrid cloud environments, the ability to analyse requirements and design scalable and secure architectures, familiarity with deploying and managing cloud-based solutions, and experience in troubleshooting and optimising technology platforms. If you are a fresher, a good way to prepare is to build a small hands-on lab with Azure or a hybrid setup and be ready to explain what you built and why.
responsibilities: Build knowledge and support the team in delivering architecture work.
Take part in problem-solving discussions.
Gather requirements with cross-functional teams and translate them into architectural solutions.
Help document architecture designs and maintain technical standards.
Suggest improvements that increase architecture efficiency.
Support junior team members with guidance on best practices.
requirements: Proficiency in Azure Stack (must have).
Experience with Linux and Microsoft Windows Server administration (good to have).
Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure and hybrid cloud environments.
Ability to analyse system requirements and design scalable, secure architectures.
Familiarity with deploying and managing cloud-based solutions.
15 years of full-time education.
jobs.aboutCompany: Accenture is a global technology and consulting company that says it has more than 775,000 people worldwide. It states that no one is ever required to pay for employment at Accenture. If anyone asks you for money, do not respond and report it to india.fc.check@accenture.com.

jobs.batch: Fresh graduates (check exact batch on the official page)
jobs.eligibility: Fresh graduates with a passion for programming; detailed criteria are on the official HCLTech page
jobs.summary: HCLTech is hiring fresh graduates for Python-based software development roles in Bhubaneswar under its Campus Beginner programme.
description: HCLTech is looking for enthusiastic and motivated fresh graduates who have a passion for programming and software development. Selected candidates will work with experienced engineering teams to develop, test and maintain Python-based applications. Along the way they will get exposure to modern software development practices, automation, AI and cloud technologies. The opening is listed under the Campus Beginner category and the work location is Bhubaneswar, Odisha.

On the job you will write and maintain Python applications and scripts, follow coding standards, and debug issues with guidance from senior developers. You will take part in code reviews and team discussions, work with databases to store and retrieve application data, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements. You will also support automation, data processing and application enhancement work, and keep learning new technologies and best practices.

The posting does not list a salary, batch or detailed skill criteria on the page we reviewed, so check the official HCLTech page before you apply. To prepare, revise Python fundamentals such as data structures, functions and file handling, practise basic SQL, and keep one or two small Python projects ready to explain in an interview.
responsibilities: Develop, test and maintain Python applications and scripts.
Write clean, efficient and reusable code that follows coding standards.
Debug and troubleshoot software issues with guidance from senior developers.
Take part in code reviews and team discussions.
Work with databases to store and retrieve application data.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements.
Support automation, data processing and application enhancement activities.
Keep learning new technologies and best practices.
requirements: Fresh graduate with a passion for programming and software development.
Working knowledge of Python.
Basic understanding of databases.
Enthusiasm for learning automation, AI and cloud technologies.
Willingness to learn from senior developers and work in a team.
jobs.aboutCompany: HCLTech is a global technology company. This Campus Beginner role is aimed at fresh graduates who want to start a software development career with mentoring from experienced engineering teams.
